plan: Given my value of $46, I aim to win while minimizing payment. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly above the average expected bid. Assuming opponents bid near their values, a bid of $30 could secure a win without overpaying. This aims to outbid others while ensuring I gain value ($46 - $30 = $16 profit if I win).

Given my value of $17, bidding higher than $17 risks overpaying. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly below my value, anticipating others might bid close to their values. A bid of $15.1 could win if others bid low, allowing me to profit $1.9 if I pay the third-highest bid of $15. If others bid higher, I lose nothing.

Given my value of $28 for the prize, I aim to bid below my value to ensure profit if I win. A bid around $18 maximizes potential profit because it is below my value, allowing a net gain if I win. This strategy assumes other bidders may bid close to their values, and I avoid overbidding and potential loss.
